ai_summary: Accelya Solutions India Limited has filed an appeal against an order from the Regional Provident Fund Commissioner - II, which had mandated a payment of INR 2.72 crore related to provident fund proceedings. As part of this appeal, the company has deposited INR 68.13 lakh (25% of the ordered amount), indicating an immediate cash outflow and highlighting an ongoing regulatory dispute concerning potential non-compliance with provident fund regulations.
